speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat
text: asked the Minister for Manpower when a childcare centre or a school is officially ordered to be closed because of links to COVID-19 cases (a) whether the Ministry can consider granting the parents special leave that is beyond the normal childcare leave so as to take care of the child under such circumstances; and (b) if so, whether the leave can cover the period that the childcare centre or school is closed.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Parents may wish to tap on these leave entitlements to cope with closures.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: A more sustainable way to support parents would be through providing more flexible work arrangements.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: In the past year, more employers have also adopted flexible work arrangements such as flexible hours or remote work.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: These go a long way in helping parents and we encourage more employers to do so.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: I have one supplementary question and I think I should give the context about why I am asking the question.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: I have a few residents who have asked in relation to some of the childcare centre closures because of COVID-19.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: They have been affected and the main reasons are varied.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: First, it affects a large number of parents at one go.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: Second, if we do face an endemic scenario, going forward, and we do see start-stop scenarios, there will be multiple childcare centre closures, particularly because of the third point I am going to mention, because childcare centres cover a segment of the population which are parents with children below 12 years of age and they are not vaccinated.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: So, the possibility or probability will be higher that the closures would be there.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: Fourthly, some of the parents that came to me highlighted situations where the employers are not enlightened with regard to flexible work arrangements.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: In those type of scenarios, it does matter.

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: And that is part of business continuity planning as well.

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: So, I do urge employers to adopt that flexible attitude to be enlightened, as the Member has said, that this is really a hump that we all got to get through together.

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: If we take a very legalistic approach and only wait to act when there is guidance given, then I think we may be behind the curve in trying to deal with workplace transmission.
